Every attempt earns **1** mark, and a hit **2** more. Against an opponent above your rank you earn **20%** more for each level between you, below it 20% less for each, up to **200%** in all and down to nothing:

| The opponent's level against your rank | 5 below | 4 below | 3 below | 2 below | 1 below | the same | 1 above | 2 above | 3 above | 4 above | 5 above |
|---|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| Marks | 0% | 20% | 40% | 60% | 80% | 100% | 120% | 140% | 160% | 180% | 200% |
| A miss earns | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| A hit earns | 0 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 4 | 5 | 5 | 6 |
